topic: Analytics data display issue in Japan
summary_markdown:
A user ([p4]) inquired about 'NA' values appearing in the analytics dashboard for screens located in Japan. Someone ([p2]) initially suggested it was a display issue and confirmed that data retention appeared correct, promising to fix it.

Later, someone ([p2]) announced that the corrected version would be released within a couple of hours today on the staging environment.
decisions: The analytics dashboard displaying NA values in Japan will be fixed.
action_items: Someone ([p2]) will release the corrected version to the staging environment within a few hours.
